message.content: {"cause": "LOCK_CONTENTION", "blocker_session_id": "session_dbbd99260e63", "waiter_session_id": "session_6f0bc72e72cb", "evidence_refs": ["observation_8a3989003a18", "task_e041ffd5df0e"], "explanation": "pg_stat_activity shows the business request session_6f0bc72e72cb active on 'UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1' waiting on Lock:transactionid, blocked by session_dbbd99260e63 (pid 949), which is 'idle in transaction' after having executed the same UPDATE (it holds the row/transaction lock and is waiting on ClientRead, i.e., an uncommitted abandoned transaction). Root cause: lock contention from an idle-in-transaction session holding the lock; remediation is rollback of session_dbbd99260e63, which is eligible as a project-owned session and preserves the business request.
